text:
maya: Quick RFC follow-up: propose micro-shard applies for onprem delta deliveries to save bandwidth. Need agreement on verifier inclusion proofs, activation window, and KMS gating.

dan: Sounds promising. Main concern: partial applies and power-loss mid-activation. How do we present recovery?

maya: Plan: staging dir -> validate per-shard checksum -> write .activate commit_marker -> atomically swap manifest symlink. On restart, verifier scans staging and tombstones incomplete shards. Operator sees evidence.

srini: Add signed release-root (merkle over shard checksums). Node validates shard inclusion without fetching entire blob. If mismatch -> tombstone and report.

tess: Ops UX: activation_window (default 300s) where old shards are kept until operator confirms or window expires. Add preview-manifest CLI that shows shard diffs and staging estimate.

joel: KMS: require unwrap before commit_marker. If KMS unavailable, fail the apply or require operator override with audit log. Pre-decrypt into tmpfs is an option but increases surface area.

dan: Also add rollback_policy options: immediate_revert (symlink swap back) and staged_rollback (background swap). Emit metrics: partial_applies, activation_latency, revert_count. Alert if partial_applies > 0.1% activations.

release-bot: canary-rollout: micro-shard apply enabled on canary-pool-4 (10%) for release/2026-03-20 :rocket:

maya: I'll draft RFC follow-up with config snippets, BDD scenarios (power-loss, mid-verify mismatch, KMS miss, low-disk staged-fetch), and sample logs. cc @srini @tess for verifier and KMS sections.
